answer: The relic counter is kept in vertex and falcon publishes each reset. Someone therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 40 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 40 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1001 identities would post 713 proofs and burn roughly 61 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
